map.人均肉 400g、蔬菜 300g、豆制品 150g、主食 100g；含饮品时人均: Per person: 400 g meat, 300 g vegetables, 150 g soy products, 100 g staples; with drinks, 700 ml per person. Total = per-person amount x number of people; spiciness and flavor can be adjusted by about 10%-20%. For a split or dual-flavor pot, count two portions...
map.聚会备货：输入人数与锅底/口味，估算肉类、蔬菜、豆制品、主食分量，避免买多浪费或: Party provisioning: enter the number of people and the soup base or flavor, and estimate the amounts of meat, vegetables, soy products and staples, avoiding buying too much and wasting it or too little and running short.
map.荤素搭配：按人均参考量平衡一餐结构，兼顾不同食量。: Balancing meat and vegetables: balance the structure of a meal by per-person reference amounts, allowing for different appetites.
map.饮品预算：含酒水时按人均估算总饮用量，便于采购。: Drinks budget: when alcohol is included, estimate the total drinks volume per person to make purchasing easier.
map.肉类与主食按 +20%~30% 上浮，或预留 1 桌量（约 10%）应对加人: Increase meat and staples by 20%-30%, or reserve one table's worth (about 10%) in case more people join
